text:
World War II ended in 1945.

Having ended with the unconditional surrender of Japan, which was announced on 15 August 1945 (and formally signed on 2 September 1945), the war in Europe had already concluded earlier — with Germany's surrender on 8 May 1945 (V-E Day, Victory in Europe Day).

So, depending on which theatre of war you're referring to, the war ended at different times in 1945.
